blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) code ko design aur munazzam karne ka aisa tareeqa hai jis se code sambhalna aur samajhna aasan hota hai. Sochein aap khilona blocks se ek namoone ka shehar bana rahe hain. Is shehar mein har imarat, gaari aur insaan ek alag cheez (entity) hai jise aap design kar sakte hain aur jis se kaam le sakte hain. OOP mein inhi alag cheezon ko objects kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Namoone ke shehar ki tasveer mein har imarat ya gari OOP mein kis cheez ki numaindagi karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Object: apne data aur rawayye wali alag cheez.

items: OOP: program ko alag alag objects (cheezon) ki shakal mein banana.
